description: Source code implementing JSON-RPC endpoints for a persistent store in the WPEFramework plugin, including registration of RPC methods, handling get/set/delete operations, and managing storage sizes and limits.

classes.name: PersistentStore
classes.description: Class implementing JSON-RPC endpoints for persistent storage operations, including key-value management, namespace handling, and storage size/limit controls.

methods.name: RegisterAll
methods.description: Registers all RPC endpoints for persistent store operations.

methods.name: endpoint_setValue
methods.description: Sets a value in the persistent store for a given key and namespace.

methods.name: endpoint_getValue
methods.description: Retrieves a value and TTL for a given key in the store.

methods.name: endpoint_deleteKey
methods.description: Deletes a key from the store.

methods.name: endpoint_deleteNamespace
methods.description: Deletes an entire namespace from the store.

methods.name: endpoint_getKeys
methods.description: Retrieves all keys within a namespace.

methods.name: endpoint_getStorageSize
methods.description: Deprecated. Retrieves storage sizes per namespace.

methods.name: endpoint_getStorageSizes
methods.description: Retrieves storage sizes for all namespaces.

methods.name: endpoint_getNamespaceStorageLimit
methods.description: Gets storage limit for a namespace.

methods.name: endpoint_setNamespaceStorageLimit
methods.description: Sets storage limit for a namespace.
